```{r define path}
#herre::here() #check folder path
basedir <- here()
```

```{r import excel}
# Import only lab data sheet from excel file
table_lab_overall <- readxl::read_xlsx(
  here("data", "RNAseq-CarTrans_Long_Clinical Data_ALL PATIENTS_Export.xlsx"),
  sheet = "Lab Data",
  col_names = TRUE
)
```

```{r clean table_lab}
#Previous labeling of EMB3 still gets imported, although it`s not visible in original excel
# Remove double EMB 3 entries
table_lab <- table_lab_overall %>%
  dplyr::select(
    -`Trop T EMB 3`,
    -`CK total EMB 3`,
    -`NT-proBNP EMB 3`,
    -`CRP EMB 3`,
    -`Leukozyten EMB 3`
  )

# -`Date of lab EMB 3` is not found
```

```{r clean rejection biopsies}
# Clean the rejection episodes with following definition: exclude all values with biopsies indicating non-relevant rejection, ISHLT (2004) ≤ACR2R

#Clean EMBX1
table_lab <- table_lab %>%
  mutate(across(contains("EMBX1"), function(col) { 
                col[.data$ID%in% c("CarTrans-Long-001",
                                   "CarTrans-Long-002",
                                   "CarTrans-Long-003",
                                   "CarTrans-Long-005",
                                   "CarTrans-Long-008",
                                   "CarTrans-Long-010",
                                   "CarTrans-Long-014",
                                   "CarTrans-Long-016",
                                   "CarTrans-Long-017",
                                   "CarTrans-Long-018",
                                   "CarTrans-Long-019",
                                   "CarTrans-Long-020",
                                   "CarTrans-Long-023",
                                   "CarTrans-Long-024",
                                   "CarTrans-Long-036",
                                   "CarTrans-Long-037")] <-NA
                col}))

#Clean EMBX2
table_lab <- table_lab %>%
  mutate(across(contains("EMBX2"), function(col) { 
                col[.data$ID%in% c("CarTrans-Long-001",
                                   "CarTrans-Long-002",
                                   "CarTrans-Long-004",
                                   "CarTrans-Long-005",
                                   "CarTrans-Long-006",
                                   "CarTrans-Long-014",
                                   "CarTrans-Long-018")] <-NA
                col}))

#Clean EMBX3
table_lab <- table_lab %>%
  mutate(across(contains("EMBX3"), function(col) { 
                col[.data$ID%in% c("CarTrans-Long-002",
                                   "CarTrans-Long-004",
                                   "CarTrans-Long-008")] <-NA
                col}))

#Clean EMBX4
table_lab <- table_lab %>%
  mutate(across(contains("EMBX3"), function(col) { 
                col[.data$ID%in%"CarTrans-Long-006"] <-NA
                col}))
```



# 1. NTproBNP Kinetics
```{r reshape NTproBNP}
# Remove NTproBNP_EMB6
table_lab_NTproBNP <- table_lab %>% dplyr::select(-NTproBNP_EMB6)

ntpro_cols <- grep("^NTproBNP", colnames(table_lab_NTproBNP), value = TRUE)
#Set NAs to numeric
table_lab_NTproBNP <- table_lab_NTproBNP %>%mutate(across(all_of(ntpro_cols),~ as.numeric(str_replace_all(as.character(.), "[^0-9.]", ""))
                                        ))

#Prep dataframe
df_long_NTproBNP <- table_lab_NTproBNP %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("NTproBNP"),
    names_to = "Timepoint",
    values_to = "NTproBNP"
  )%>%
  dplyr::select(ID, Timepoint, NTproBNP)  # only keep patient + measurement

#Relabel timepoints
df_long_NTproBNP <- df_long_NTproBNP %>%
  mutate(
    Timepoint = str_remove(Timepoint, "NTproBNP_"),
    Timepoint = recode(Timepoint,
      "BL" = "Baseline",
      "EMB1" = "Week 1",
      "EMB2" = "Week 2",
      "EMB3" = "Month 1–3",
      "EMB4" = "Month 4–6",
      "EMB5" = "Month 12",
      "EMBX1" = "Rejection",
      "EMBX2" = "Rejection",
      "EMBX3" = "Rejection",
      "EMBX4" = "Rejection"
    )
  )

#Set order
df_long_NTproBNP$Timepoint <- factor(
  df_long_NTproBNP$Timepoint,
  levels = c(
    "Baseline",
    "Week 1",
    "Week 2",
    "Month 1–3",
    "Month 4–6",
    "Month 12",
    "Rejection"
  )
)
```

```{r boxplot NTproBNP kinetics color per patient, fig.width=9, fig.height=6, out.width="100%"}
ggplot(df_long_NTproBNP, aes(x = Timepoint, y = NTproBNP)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(aes(color=ID), width = 0.2, alpha = 0.4) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "NT-proBNP kinetics post transplantation per patient",
    x = "",
    y = "NT-proBNP (log, ng/L)"
  ) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "bottom")
```
```{r boxplot NTproBNP kinetics, out.width="100%"}
p_NTproBNP<- ggplot(df_long_NTproBNP, aes(x = Timepoint, y = NTproBNP)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, fill="lightblue") +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, alpha = 0.4) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "NT-proBNP kinetics post transplantation",
    x = "",
    y = "NT-proBNP (log, ng/L)"
  ) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5))

print(p_NTproBNP)
```
